# Codex Pooler Public Docs For Agents

Last reviewed: 2026-08-12
Canonical docs: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/
Short answers: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/answers.md

Codex Pooler is a self-hosted pooled AI gateway. Every supported client configures exactly one public model: gemma3. The server owns the private target, fixed reasoning policy, account selection, retry, continuity, quota, and accounting decisions.

Client entry points:
- Ollama: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/ollama/ with base URL https://codex-pooler.example.com, a Pool API key, and model gemma3.
- Claude Code: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/claude-code/ with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://codex-pooler.example.com, all Anthropic model aliases set to gemma3, and a Pool API key.
- OpenAI SDKs: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/openai-compatible/ with base URL https://codex-pooler.example.com/v1, a Pool API key, and model gemma3.
- Codex CLI: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/codex-cli/ with base URL https://codex-pooler.example.com/backend-api/codex, a Pool API key, and model gemma3.
- Exact route and support table: https://docs.codex-pooler.com/reference/runtime-routes/.

Other client guides all use gemma3:
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/aider/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/cline/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/continue/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/goose/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/hermes/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/kilo/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/omp/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/openclaw/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/opencode/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/openhands/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/pi/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/trae/
- https://docs.codex-pooler.com/clients/windmill/

Credential rules:
- Use Pool API keys for /api, /v1, and /backend-api runtime routes.
- Use only an operator-owned MCP token for /mcp.
- Never configure an upstream account credential in a client.
- Never place raw credentials in URLs, docs, prompts, tickets, screenshots, or logs.

Compatibility rules:
- Ollama /api/chat and /api/generate support native JSON/NDJSON; discovery exposes only gemma3. Model mutation, blobs, and embeddings are unsupported.
- Anthropic compatibility is limited to POST /v1/messages and POST /v1/messages/count_tokens.
- OpenAI compatibility includes models, Responses, Chat Completions, legacy Completions, usage, selected files, transcription, and image routes. It is not full OpenAI parity, and /v1/realtime is unsupported.
- Codex compatibility is an explicit /backend-api/codex route family, not a wildcard app-server proxy.
- Codex CLI and Claude Code preserve their own local agent runtimes. Protocol adapters are not token-for-token equivalent.

Privacy and caching rules:
- Clients see only gemma3 in protocol identity fields; provider, account, assignment, private target, upstream request IDs, and unsafe headers/errors are removed.
- Arbitrary generated prose, filenames, and tool arguments are not blindly rewritten.
- Codex Pooler does not cache completed responses. Supported cache/session values are converted into Pool/API-key-scoped one-way identities to improve locality without guaranteeing a cache hit.
- Operator diagnostics retain truthful sanitized metadata, but raw prompts, completions, tool payloads, media bodies, websocket frames, keys, credentials, and raw facade affinity values are not request-log content.

Local examples use http://localhost:4000. Deployed examples use https://codex-pooler.example.com. Documentation links use https://docs.codex-pooler.com.
